name: MonarchCard
title: Card
summary: A bordered surface that groups related content, optionally elevated or tappable.
whenToUse: To group content that belongs together, or as a tappable summary that opens a detail screen.
whenNotToUse: Do not nest cards. Do not put other tappable elements inside a tappable card.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCard(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, elevated: Boolean = false, contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(16.dp), content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchCard(onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, elevated: Boolean = false, contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(16.dp), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

options.name: onClick
options.description: Second overload: makes the whole card tappable.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Tappable overload: whether the card can be tapped.

options.name: elevated
options.description: The raised surface color and a shadow.

options.name: contentPadding
options.description: The space between the edge and the content.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: Tappable overload: to observe press and focus.

states.name: static
states.description: A surface with the default border.

states.name: elevated
states.description: The raised surface, the subtle border and the md shadow.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Tappable overload: taps are ignored; the look does not change.

appearance: The surface color with a 1dp border and 12dp corners. In the dark themes an elevated card is told apart by the raised surface color more than by its shadow.
platformNotes: The web card has header, footer and subtle variants; here the content is a plain column and the app composes headers itself.
accessibility: A static card adds no semantics; its content is read as usual.
A tappable card is one actionable TalkBack element that reads its content.
A tappable card draws the focus ring.
Sets the content color to the default text color of the theme.
edgeCases: A tappable card shorter than 48dp still reserves a 48dp touch target.
A disabled tappable card looks the same as an enabled one; say why in its content.
